title: Chapter 6418: Pot Smash

Chapter 6418: Pot Smash

Chapter 6418: Pot Smash

“The traitor.” Ocean-gaze frowned.

Regarding seniority, he was from the same generation as Luosha Devil Emperor. However, the two rarely met and had no strong ties. After leaving Trinity, they occasionally spoke on many matters.

“Senior Uncle, please give the command and I shall be the vanguard.” Iron-spear said.

Others understood his intention - needing the help of Imperial League as a distraction while he focused on catching Luosha Devil Emperor.

“We are no match for them since they have Heavenly Crane Master, he is one with the island, it is unbreakable.” Ocean-gaze refused.

“Please don’t worry, other ancestors from the sect will come.” Iron-spear said.

“My origin aside, Imperial League is independent from Trinity. Go back.” Ocean-gaze said.

“Senior Uncle, you are still a member of Trinity...” Iron-spear’s expression changed.

“Iron-spear, I do not wish to shed blood on my birthday. We will not comply.” Ocean-gaze interrupted him.

“I have a formal command from the trinity, please reconsider.” Iron-spear took out a badge.

“Buzz.” The power of an eternal anima poured down and surrounded Imperial League.

This badge came from the trinity themselves and was blessed with their power.

The emperors felt mountains pushing down on their chest and suffocating them. Ocean-gaze was slightly startled since the trinity was dreadful.

This put him in a tough position. He didn’t want to work for Trinity but lacked the power to resist.

“What did you get down there?” Someone asked him and broke the tense atmosphere.

“Thank you, Young Noble, I benefited from the trip.” Ocean-gaze saw Li Qiye approaching.

Although he didn’t get to eat his noodles, he did find a fortune down there so his birthday was not all negative.

“Who are you?” Iron-spear didn’t appreciate someone interrupting his command while holding the badge.

“Why does it matter?” Li Qiye responded.

“Trinity is conducting official business. Please leave if you are not involved.” Iron-spear said.

“What’s Trinity?” Li Qiye asked Alch-deer, surprising everyone.

“Ancestor, it is a kingdom.” Alch-deer replied.

“I see.” Li Qiye casually replied.

Iron-spear was furious at the lack of respect and acknowledgment from the ordinary brat.

“You court death!” A spear energy descended and pierced through the stars, enough to leave a crater.

“Bam!” However, Li Qiye easily blocked it with the pot Ocean-gaze used to boil noodles.

“This is the power of a primal ancestor?” Li Qiye frowned.

Iron-spear’s expression became ugly while Ocean-gaze smiled awkwardly.

“State your name.” Iron-spear realized he was facing a big shot.

“Idiot, you’re not qualified to ask.” Li Qiye chuckled and swung the pot.

“You dare?!” Iron-spear summoned a physical spear this time, wielding enough force to break all of Imperial League.

Alas, Li Qiye’s casual swing of an ordinary pot sent the spear flying.

“Here’s the punishment.” Li Qiye slapped his face repeatedly with the pot.

Iron-spear heard the sounds of his cheekbones breaking.

“Scram.” Li Qiye added more force and broke his skull, sending him flying like a meteor. Blood splashed down where he used to be like a rainbow.

Li Qiye spared him and didn’t reduce him to a bloody mist. Nevertheless, this rendered the crowd speechless.

Ocean-gaze, a heaven ancestor, couldn’t have done this since he wasn’t strong enough. They also noticed how Li Qiye didn’t activate his aura and cultivation. He looked like a mortal swinging a pot. This made Iron-spear look like a fly, utterly helpless against the pot.

All eyes were on Li Qiye - wondering how strong he was compared to Everlasting Jiang and North Kun God.

“Rumble!” Suddenly, explosions came from above and islands rained down.

Cracks appeared on the crystal boundary separating Isles of Evil and Imperial League.
